capabilities: Record income, expense, transfer, and balance-adjustment entries in Markdown
Query and filter entries with a cashlog query syntax in code blocks
Render bar, line, and pie charts and tables from entry data
Track multiple accounts and balances in a dashboard panel
Set spending budgets and income goals with period-aware progress
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual only (copy release files into the plugins folder). UI is bilingual (English and Chinese) with Chinese documentation available. Requires Obsidian v1.7.2+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log transactions in notes and then filter, summarize, or visualize them as financial data.

relations.evidence: Use ```cashlog-chart code blocks to render visualizations powered by Chart.js.

summary: Personal finance tracker that records income and expenses as emoji-marked Markdown list items, with querying, charts, accounts, budgets, and goals.
